actions.label: Open Location overview
actions.meaning: Opens the Overview tab of Location, which shows current sharing status and the quick actions.

actions.label: Open Location people
actions.meaning: Opens the People tab of Location, which lists the people and circles you share with.

actions.label: Open Location links
actions.meaning: Opens the Links tab of Location, which lists temporary sharing links you have created.

actions.label: Share my location
actions.meaning: Opens the share composer, where you pick who to share your location with and for how long. Nothing is shared until you send it. If the person to share with is already named in the same request (e.g. 'share my location with Alice'), call select_share_recipient directly instead -- it navigates here and selects them in one step.
aliases: let someone see where i am

actions.label: Ask for someone's location
actions.meaning: Opens the request composer, where you ask another person to share their location with you. If the person is already named in the same request (e.g. 'ask Alice where she is'), call select_ask_recipient directly instead -- it navigates here and selects them in one step.

actions.label: Pick someone to ask for their location
actions.meaning: Finds the person or people you named among your connections and selects them in the request composer, so you can see who is picked before anything is sent. Multiple people can be named in one turn, e.g. 'Alice and Bob'. It only selects: sending the request is still a separate, confirmed step. Works from any screen: it navigates to this composer itself, so open_ask does not need to be called first when a name is already given.

workflow_steps.label: Pick someone to ask for their location

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Who do you want to ask?

actions.label: Send the location request
actions.meaning: Sends a request to see their location to the people already picked in the request composer. It never chooses who: if nobody is selected it stops and asks you to pick someone first.

actions.label: Invite someone to Location
actions.meaning: Opens the invite screen, where you invite someone who is not on Hushh yet to share location with you.

actions.label: Create a circle
actions.meaning: Opens the create-circle screen, where you name a new circle of people to share location with as a group. If the circle's name is already said in the same request (e.g. 'create a circle called Family'), call create_circle directly instead -- it creates the circle without opening this screen.

actions.label: Join a circle
actions.meaning: Opens the join-circle screen, where you enter an invite code to join someone else's circle. Use this only when you have a code to type in; if you already have a pending circle invitation waiting for you, call accept_circle_invite directly instead -- no code needed.

actions.label: Create a temporary link
actions.meaning: Opens the temporary link screen, where you create a link that shows your location for a limited time to anyone who opens it.

actions.label: Check in
actions.meaning: Opens check-in, where you send a one-off note of where you are to people you choose.

actions.label: Open emergency SOS
actions.meaning: Opens the emergency SOS screen, where an alert with your location can be sent to your emergency contacts. Opening it does not send anything. Say this to look at the screen or manage contacts, not to alert anyone -- to send a real alert immediately, use trigger_sos.

actions.label: Open emergency contacts
actions.meaning: Opens the emergency SMS contacts screen, where you choose who receives a text message when you raise an SOS.

actions.label: Open Location privacy settings
actions.meaning: Opens the Location settings screen, which holds the privacy and precision controls for location sharing.

actions.label: Open active location shares
actions.meaning: Opens the list of shares that are live right now, so you can see and stop what other people can currently see. Say this when no specific person is named yet; if a person IS already named (e.g. 'stop sharing with Alice'), call stop_share directly instead.
aliases: who can see me right now

actions.label: Open locations shared with me
actions.meaning: Opens the list of people who are currently sharing their location with you.

actions.label: Open location requests to review
actions.meaning: Opens the requests waiting on your decision, where you approve or decline people asking to see your location.

actions.label: Add people to share location with
actions.meaning: Opens Connect, where you find and connect with people. Location can only be shared with a connection or a circle member, so this is the way out of an empty people list.

actions.label: Open the location map
actions.meaning: Opens the full-screen map of the people sharing location with you.

actions.label: Refresh location
actions.meaning: Reloads location sharing state so shares, requests and grants are current.

actions.label: Pause my location
actions.meaning: Stops this device sending new location updates and takes you off nearby presence. People you have already granted keep their grant, but it stops moving until you resume. This affects your device for everyone at once; to end a share with just one person while staying visible to everyone else, use stop_share instead.

actions.label: Pick someone for the share
actions.meaning: Finds the person or people you named among your connections and selects them in the share composer, so you can see who is picked before anything is sent. Multiple people can be named in one turn, e.g. 'Alice and Bob'. It only selects: starting the share is still a separate, confirmed step. Works from any screen: it navigates to this composer itself, so open_share does not need to be called first when a name is already given.

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Who do you want to share with?

actions.label: Share with the people I picked
actions.meaning: Shares your live location with the people already selected in the share composer, for the length of time you say. It never chooses who: if nobody is selected it stops and asks you to pick someone first.
aliases: share with the people i picked
share my location with these people

required_inputs.name: duration_hours
required_inputs.prompt: For how long? You can say 30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours or 24 hours.

actions.label: Stop sharing with someone
actions.meaning: Stops an active share with the named person immediately, so your location no longer updates for them. It only ends the one share you named; every other active share is untouched. This is scoped to one person and does not touch your device's own broadcasting -- to stop sharing with everyone at once, use pause_updates instead.

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Whose access do you want to stop?

actions.label: Approve a location request
actions.meaning: Approves the named person's pending request to see your location, starting a share for it. It only acts on a request already waiting; it never invites someone new.

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Whose request do you want to approve?

actions.label: Decline a location request
actions.meaning: Declines the named person's pending request to see your location. It only acts on a request already waiting and does not stop any share already in place with them.

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Whose request do you want to decline?

actions.label: Change how long a share lasts
actions.meaning: Changes how much longer the named person can see your live location, without stopping and restarting the share. It only acts on a share already active with them.

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Whose access time do you want to change?

required_inputs.name: duration_hours
required_inputs.prompt: How long should it last now? You can say 30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours or 24 hours.

workflow_steps.label: Change how long a share lasts

actions.label: Stop the active SOS
actions.meaning: Ends an SOS that is currently running and revokes every location share it created. It does not tell anyone you are safe.

actions.label: Turn automatic approval of location requests on or off
actions.meaning: Controls whether incoming location requests are approved without asking the person each time. Applies only to requests that arrive after it is switched on; requests already waiting still need an explicit answer.
aliases: stop asking me about location requests

required_inputs.name: enabled
required_inputs.prompt: Should automatic approval be on or off?

workflow_steps.label: Turn automatic approval of location requests on or off

actions.label: Add an emergency contact
actions.meaning: Adds one person to the list who are alerted and receive your live location if you trigger an SOS. Only people who have finished their own Location setup can be added.

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Who should I add as an emergency contact?

actions.label: Remove an emergency contact
actions.meaning: Removes one person from the list who are alerted and receive your live location if you trigger an SOS.
aliases: take them off my sos list

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Which emergency contact should I remove?

actions.label: Resume my location
actions.meaning: Turns location updates back on for this device and refreshes your live position. This makes you visible again to everyone you have an active grant with, so it asks before it runs.

actions.label: Create a new circle
actions.meaning: Creates a circle with the name the person says, without opening the create-circle screen. A new circle starts empty; people join only after they accept an invitation.

required_inputs.name: name
required_inputs.prompt: What should the circle be called?

actions.label: Add someone to a circle
actions.meaning: Invites one or more of your connections to join a circle -- multiple people can be named in one turn, e.g. 'Alice and Bob'. They are not in the circle until they accept, so this sends an invitation rather than adding them outright. Only people already connected to you can be invited.

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Who should I invite to the circle?

required_inputs.name: circle
required_inputs.prompt: Which circle?

actions.label: Remove someone from a circle
actions.meaning: Removes one person from a circle, so they stop receiving your location through it. The circle itself and its other members are left untouched.
aliases: take them out of the circle

required_inputs.name: person
required_inputs.prompt: Who should I remove from the circle?

required_inputs.name: circle
required_inputs.prompt: Which circle?

actions.label: Rename a circle
actions.meaning: Changes a circle's name. It only renames the circle; its members, invitations, and shares through it are untouched.

required_inputs.name: circle
required_inputs.prompt: Which circle do you want to rename?

required_inputs.name: name
required_inputs.prompt: What should it be called instead?

actions.label: Leave a circle
actions.meaning: Removes you from a circle you belong to, so you stop sharing your location with it and stop seeing its members' shares. The circle itself and its other members are untouched. Its owner cannot leave -- they must delete it or hand off ownership first.

required_inputs.name: circle
required_inputs.prompt: Which circle do you want to leave?

actions.label: Delete a circle
actions.meaning: Permanently deletes a circle you own. Every member loses the access and sharing that circle provided; this cannot be undone. Only the circle's owner can delete it.

required_inputs.name: circle
required_inputs.prompt: Which circle do you want to delete?

actions.label: Accept a circle invitation
actions.meaning: Joins a circle you were invited to. Once accepted you start sharing your location with, and seeing shares from, that circle's members. This only works on an invitation already pending for you; if you have a code instead, use open_join_circle.

required_inputs.name: circle
required_inputs.prompt: Which circle invitation do you want to accept?

actions.label: Decline a circle invitation
actions.meaning: Declines a pending invitation to join a circle. Nothing is shared and the invitation is closed; you can be invited again later.

required_inputs.name: circle
required_inputs.prompt: Which circle invitation do you want to decline?

actions.label: Save your current location as a place
actions.meaning: Saves where you are right now as a named place -- home, work, or a custom name. Home and work replace any earlier place saved under that same category; a custom name is added alongside your existing places.

required_inputs.name: label
required_inputs.prompt: What should I call this place?

workflow_steps.label: Save your current location as a place

actions.label: Delete a saved place
actions.meaning: Permanently removes a saved place from your list. It does not affect any active or past shares of your location; it only forgets the saved point itself.

required_inputs.name: label
required_inputs.prompt: Which saved place do you want to delete?

actions.label: Send the check-in you have open
actions.meaning: Sends the check-in currently on screen to the people already selected there, using its already-set duration and message. It only works while the Check-In screen is open; it does not open Check-In or change who or how long it targets.

actions.label: Send an SOS alert
actions.meaning: Sends an emergency alert to your ready emergency contacts right now, sharing your live location with them and emailing anyone a push notification could not reach. It does not call emergency services. This is a real, immediate alert, not the SOS screen -- to just look at the screen or manage contacts without alerting anyone, use open_sos.

required_inputs.name: note
required_inputs.prompt: Anything you want your contacts to know? You can also just say send it.
